reason: New test-only function that cannot affect production behavior; it adds coverage for hint propagation in compactor Write.
headline: New test checks FromSelectedSeries hint propagates through compactor Write
summary: Adds TestCompactSelectedSeries_HintPropagation, which creates a selected-series block, rewrites it via compactor.Write with its own meta as base, and asserts the new block keeps the FromSelectedSeries hint. Test-only, so a line-by-line review can be skipped.
